name: cache_blocking
hypothesis: The selected traversal already exists in the measured LIBXSMM reference. With x0=B and x1=A, the outer loop advances by 64 output rows. Each inner iteration computes two 32×32 tiles: the second uses C+65536 bytes (32 rows) and scratch+128 bytes (32 FP32 values). It then advances B and C by 128 bytes (32 columns) and resets the scratch pointer. This is the requested 64×32 macroblock traversal with the existing K loops. Implementing it would repeat the tested reference. No edits or performance claims are made.
